description: Check the status of an async download request (same format/quality/language used in panda_request_download). Returns {status, url?} — `url` (a temporary signed link) is present when status is 'ready'.

language.description: Audio language: 'default' for the original audio, or the code of a dubbed audio of the video (e.g. 'en', 'es' — see audios[] in panda_get_video). 'original' is read as 'default'.

quality.description: Quality: one of 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p, original ('1080' is read as '1080p'). 'original' is the uploaded file; the others must be in the video's available_resolutions.

name: panda_check_download_status
title: Check Download Status
